entities.summary: The Haparanda Line is a 165-kilometer (103 mi) long railway line between Boden and Haparanda in Sweden. From Haparanda, a 3-kilometer (1.9 mi) rail line continues to Torneå on the Finnish side of the Finland–Sweden border. The line is the only Swedish railway to the Finnish border.
